title.instructions:
Each vertical stripe in `barcode` is a few seconds of a YouTube video, shrunk down to its average color. The stripes run in order from the beginning of the YouTube video to the end.

Which YouTube video is it?

criteria.ellie_goulding_love_me_like_you_do_2015: Ellie Goulding - Love Me Like You Do (2015)
criteria.mark_ronson_ft_bruno_mars_uptown_funk_20: Mark Ronson ft. Bruno Mars - Uptown Funk (2014)
criteria.the_weeknd_ft_daft_punk_starboy_2016: The Weeknd ft. Daft Punk - Starboy (2016)
criteria.bruno_mars_just_the_way_you_are_2010: Bruno Mars - Just the Way You Are (2010)
